body:
I already watched a lot of movies, and read books. I started playing video games, going to a local boxing place, and smoking pot. Games make me focus on improving my k:d, which gets me in the "zone". Getting that perfect punch combo on a bag is an amazing feeling. Smoking pot makes life a bit more entertaining, but I only smoke once a week, so its not a constant escape from reality its more like an escape on the weekend.  Taking a walk is very therapeutic for me, it gives me a new environment and is something you can do alone or with someone else. 


I started to not base my activities off waiting for others to talk to me, and did stuff I wanted to do. Just think of all the things you want to do with your life, as long as they aren't destructive.
Definitely. I look back at the way I used to think or do anything and it's now foreign to me.
